messages.subject: RpgSQL: RpgSQL archived
parts:
The R PostgreSQL driver, RpgSQL, was developed when there was no other cross platform PostgreSQL driver for R.  While it had the disadvantage of requiring Java, by leveraging RJDBC I was able to quickly develop it to fill the void of no cross platform PostgreSQL driver for R.  Now that RPostgreSQL is available cross platform and does not depend on Java RpgSQL seems less needed and I have asked CRAN to archive RpgSQL.

All old versions of RpgSQL can be found in source form at http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/RpgSQL/ .
